events.summary: Every field was a stub placeholder or contained errors (wrong length range, wrong seasonality months, generic diet/behavior text); all have been fully replaced with species-specific, sourced content drawn from Audubon, Cornell Lab/All About Birds, eBird, Birds of the World, NatureServe, and state wildlife agencies. The seasonality months array was also corrected from a winter-presence pattern to the accurate spring and fall migration windows for Florida.

events.feedback: The draft for the Yellow-throated Vireo ($Vireo\ flavifrons$) is structurally excellent and written in a great, accessible style for park visitors.A critical pass for absolute accuracy reveals a couple of factual errors and timeline inconsistencies that need to be cleaned up before you publish.Factual Corrections & Tweaks1. The Nest-Building Behavior (Major Error)The Issue: The draft states that when a Brown-headed Cowbird parasitizes their nest, this vireo "sometimes responds by building a new nest floor right over the parasitized clutch."The Correction: This is incorrect. Building a new floor over a cowbird egg is a famous defense mechanism of the Yellow Warbler, not the Yellow-throated Vireo. Yellow-throated Vireos unfortunately do not have this defense; they will either accept the cowbird egg and raise it, or abandon the entire nest completely.
